messages:
maria-k: Heads up — seeing duplicated invoices for ACME Corp (acct 4382) in today's billing run. Two PDFs generated with the same invoice_id. One PDF is missing marketplace pass-through lines (partner fees are zeroed out), the other has an extra 'onboarding_setup' line duplicated across both accounts. Anyone else hit this?

jamal: @maria-k yes I'm seeing the dup too. batch job id: batch-2026-03-23-09-12. repro steps: preview render -> two PDFs -> one with missing partner lines. :eyes:

maria-k: attaching the preview link: https://billing.redwood.internal/previews/batch-2026-03-23-09-12 (internal only)

billing-bot: Invoice generator finished: job=batch-2026-03-23-09-12 status=completed warnings=1 (partial_subledger_join)

liam: quick glance at the run log — warning matches: `WARN: partner_subledger join returned 0 rows for acct 4382; inserting zeroed pass-through lines`

jamal: that WARN shouldn't produce duplicate onboarding lines though. I see a migration worker kicked off at 09:11 that inserts a one-time onboarding fee when partner flags are stale. Looks like it ran twice for this tenant.

maria-k: so two issues: (1) partner_subledger join returning empty -> zeroed marketplace lines; (2) migration job double-inserted onboarding_setup line -> duplicated charge and duplicated invoice PDF.

sara-finance: Business needs: customer-facing invoice cannot show zeroed partner fees (looks like a hole) and we can't bill duplicate onboarding charges. We should void the extra invoice and issue a corrected PDF + credit for the dup charge. Approvals?

ops-jen: I can queue a manual regenerate for ACME and create a void on the duplicate, but I need a signoff for immediate credit memo issuance. sara-finance, can you approve? :white_check_mark:

sara-finance: Approved. Please proceed and CC finance@redwood for record.

liam: remediation steps I'm proposing — in order: 1) pause the migration worker for tenant scope, 2) re-run the invoice renderer for batch-2026-03-23-09-12 with `--dedupe-migration-lines` flag, 3) run partner_subledger backfill for acct 4382 to repopulate pass-through lines, 4) emit corrected PDF and a single credit memo for the duplicated onboarding line.

jamal: SQL snippet to check the join problem (run in reporting-read only):
```
SELECT a.account_id, p.partner_id, s.amount
FROM invoices i
JOIN accounts a ON i.account_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN partner_subledger s ON s.account_id = a.id AND s.batch_id = i.batch_id
LEFT JOIN partner_meta p ON p.account_id = a.id
WHERE i.batch_id = 'batch-2026-03-23-09-12' AND a.account_id = 4382;
```

maria-k: thanks. Also logging the duplicate detection query to avoid future double-inserts. Jamal — can you add a guard to the migration worker to skip if an onboarding_setup line already exists for that account+batch?

jamal: yeah I'll open a PR with the guard and a unit test. For immediate mitigation I'll run the dedupe flag and backfill.

billing-bot: Manual regenerate queued: job=batch-2026-03-23-09-12-rerender-1 requested_by=ops-jen ETA=3m

ops-jen: rerender started, monitoring logs. If the backfill repopulates partner_subledger it should replace the zeroed lines.

liam: note for postmortem: root cause looks like a race between partner_subledger ingestion (async from usage pipeline) and a migration job that assumed partner_meta presence. Add TTL for migration-retry and stronger idempotency on onboarding fee insertion.

sara-finance: once the corrected invoice + credit memo are pushed, please ping the customer success team to send a brief note explaining corrected invoice and credit. I can draft the template.

maria-k: thanks team — tracking in FIN-INV-342. I'll update once invoices are reissued. :thumbsup:

jamal: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/p/billing/+/1234 — adds dedupe check and improves logging.

billing-bot: Regeneration completed: job=batch-2026-03-23-09-12-rerender-1 status=completed results: 1 invoice corrected, 1 credit memo issued, pdfs_replaced=true

maria-k: confirmed corrected PDF looks good, partner pass-through lines present, onboarding_setup appears once. Closing loop with CS to notify ACME.

ops-jen: postmortem note created, will schedule a short rollback window if we need to revert anything from the migration change.

sara-finance: thanks all, please add billing impact to FIN-Q1 metrics.

maria-k: last: adding a quick check to invoice smoke tests to fail if any partner pass-through lines are zeroed for non-zero usage.

liam: nice. closing thread.
